integrity: The entire parameter claim is proved analytically, with exact attainment; finite diagnostic assertions are supplementary only. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Real two-dimensional, exactly three-facet norm family; no arbitrary polyhedral or complex generalization. Fixed regular hexagon endpoint was previously known. Potential earlier related family formula in unindexed literature remains a priority risk.
title: Exact von Neumann–Jordan profile of a square-to-hexagon deformation
